stories.title: Enfermeira goiana morre seis meses após receber diagnóstico de doença rara, diz amiga

en.title: Nurse from Goiás dies six months after rare disease diagnosis, says friend
en.summary: A 51-year-old nurse in Goiás was diagnosed with Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease, the same rare condition affecting influencer Lito Sousa, and died six months later.

stories.title: Mais de 140 desaparecem após balsa com 243 pessoas afundar no Mar de Java, na Indonésia

en.title: More than 140 missing after ferry with 243 people sinks in Java Sea, Indonesia
en.summary: A passenger ferry carrying 243 people sank in the Java Sea during a storm, with over 140 people missing, 102 rescued, and one death confirmed.

stories.title: São Paulo segue em alerta de perigo para tempestades neste domingo (13)

en.title: São Paulo remains on alert for storms this Sunday (13)
en.summary: Weather instability affecting São Paulo state is expected to continue on Sunday, following Saturday's storms that caused disappearances and flooding.

stories.title: Confira a partir das 11h deste domingo (13) o resultado do concurso 3057 da Mega-Sena

en.title: Check the result of Mega-Sena draw 3057 from 11am this Sunday (13)
en.summary: The Mega-Sena lottery draw 3057 will be held on Sunday at 11am, with the main prize estimated at 85 million reais.

stories.title: Enamed será aplicado neste domingo; veja regras para estudantes de medicina

en.title: Enamed will be administered this Sunday; see rules for medical students
en.summary: Medical students across Brazil will take the Enamed national assessment exam on Sunday, which is mandatory for those completing their degrees and certain fourth-year students meeting criteria set by the education institute.

stories.title: Prefeitura apura fiscalização de obra que desabou na zona leste de SP; cinco morreram

en.title: City hall investigates oversight of construction work that collapsed in São Paulo's east zone; five died
en.summary: Authorities are investigating the supervision of a construction project that collapsed in the eastern zone of São Paulo, resulting in five deaths.

stories.title: Trens da linha 7-rubi vão funcionar com lentidão neste domingo (13) para retirada árvore dos trilhos

en.title: Line 7-rubi trains will operate slowly on Sunday (13) to remove tree from tracks
en.summary: The ruby line will operate with reduced speed and longer intervals on Sunday to remove a large tree that fell onto the tracks near Pirituba station in northern São Paulo.

stories.title: Bombeiros localizam mais 3 corpos soterrados após queda de prédio na zona leste de SP; mortos chegam a cinco

en.title: Firefighters locate 3 more bodies buried after building collapse in São Paulo's east zone; death toll reaches five
en.summary: Rescue teams recovered three additional bodies from the rubble of a building that collapsed onto a house in the Penha neighborhood, bringing the total death toll to five.

stories.title: Mega-Sena sorteia prêmio acumulado de R$ 85 milhões neste domingo

en.title: Mega-Sena draws accumulated prize of R$ 85 million this Sunday
en.summary: Brazil's Mega-Sena lottery will draw an estimated R$ 85 million prize on Sunday, with ticket sales closing Saturday at 10 p.m. Brasília time. A simple six-number bet costs R$ 6.

stories.title: Confira a previsão do tempo para Ivaiporã neste domingo (13)

en.title: Check the weather forecast for Ivaiporã this Sunday (13)
en.summary: Ivaiporã is expected to experience rain on Sunday with temperatures between 14°C and 18°C, with a 98% chance of precipitation and an accumulated volume of 18.9 millimeters forecast.

stories.title: Balsa com 243 pessoas afunda na Indonésia e deixa mais de 140 desaparecidos

en.title: Ferry with 243 people sinks in Indonesia, leaving more than 140 missing
en.summary: A ferry carrying 243 people sank in the Java Sea in Indonesia on Sunday, resulting in more than 140 people reported missing.

stories.title: Signos: confira seu horóscopo deste domingo (13)

en.title: Signs: check your horoscope for this Sunday (13)
en.summary: A horoscope column provides daily predictions for zodiac signs, offering guidance on personality traits and recommendations for the day.

en.summary: Russia and Iran are pushing for development of Brics Pay, though progress on the initiative remains slow.

en.title: Pro-Moraes wing reacts, but Fachin maintains ruling on messages with Vorcaro
en.summary: A pro-Moraes faction has responded to developments, while Fachin proceeds with a ruling concerning messages involving Vorcaro.

stories.title: Equador vive crise eleitoral sob Noboa com partidos suspensos e eleições regionais antecipadas

en.title: Ecuador faces electoral crisis under Noboa with suspended parties and early regional elections
en.summary: Ecuador is experiencing an electoral crisis with multiple political parties suspended, affecting regional elections scheduled for November 29 and opposition candidates' ability to run for office.

stories.title: Split payment, da reforma tributária, começa de forma facultativa e só para empresas em 2027

en.title: Split payment, from tax reform, begins optionally and only for companies in 2027
en.summary: The split payment system from Brazil's tax reform will launch in the second half of 2027 as a voluntary option limited to business-to-business transactions, according to the Federal Revenue Service.

stories.title: Como Vorcaro pagava os servidores do BC por informações

en.title: How Vorcaro Paid BC Servers for Information
en.summary: Federal Police investigation reveals that two Central Bank department heads received at least R$ 6.8 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro for informal advisory services, including guidance on defending his bank's interests in meetings with Central Bank leadership.
